definition: A constant in a model, such as $k$, $a$ or $c$ in $f(x) = ka^{x} + c$, found from the situation and then kept fixed while the variable changes.
Using a model to predict a value outside the range of data it was built from; less reliable, because the trend may not continue there.
Using a model to predict a value inside the range of data it was built from; usually more reliable than extrapolation, but only as good as the model's fit.
A known value at the start of a situation, usually at $t = 0$, which you substitute into a model to find a parameter.
